item.statement: h(theta) <= sum_j Re(beta_j) kappa_j(delta) <= sum_j A_j kappa_j(delta) with coverage kappa_j(delta)=1-cos(2 pi j delta/p)
item.what_to_check: Analogue of Morwani Sec 4 phase condition; check whether anyone states the amplitude-coverage bound

chk.evidence:
Morwani et al. ICLR 2024 (arXiv 2311.07568v2 HTML, fetched):
- Sec 3.2 / Lemma 5 gives the class-weighted margin.
- The Sec 4 proof outline uses uniform class weighting tau = 1/(p-1), which gives E[psi'] = 2/((p-1)p^2) sum_{j!=0} u^(j)v^(j)w^(-j).
- The phase condition theta_u* + theta_v* = theta_w* is part of Theorem 7, which is in Section 4. So the paper's "Section 4" pointer is correct, and this settles the open point in LIT_cite.md.
- Our lemma puts all the weight on a single offset delta. Averaged uniformly over delta, it reduces to Morwani's quantity (p/(p-1)) sum Re beta_j, so it strictly refines their bound.

The 1-cos separation for idealized phase-aligned cosine logits is known:
- Nanda et al. 2023: logits are proportional to sum alpha_k cos(w_k(a+b-c)).
- McCracken et al. arXiv 2505.18266 Thm 4.7: h(k) = sum_l cos(2 pi f_l (k-i-j)/n), with a bound on h(i+j)-h(k). This is an idealized model, not a bound for arbitrary networks.
- Kam, Bessafi, Cadet arXiv 2609.17926 (15 Sep 2026, NeurReps review), App. A.3.2 Eq. 15: Delta_S(beta) = min_s sum_k beta_k(1-cos(omega_k s)). It is introduced as a definition or heuristic ("the logit separation ... at offset s is ..."; loss <= log(1+(p-1)e^{-Delta})). It is amplitude-only, with no phases and no statement for arbitrary networks.

Not found anywhere: a rigorous upper bound on the min-margin of an arbitrary network (with interference and misaligned phases) by the amplitude-weighted coverage at each offset. The lemma is elementary, though, and should be presented as an adaptation.

Query run: "modular addition margin upper bound Fourier amplitude 1-cos offset logit separation neural network lemma", plus targeted HTML reads. Notes: /Users/ruhaanrajadhyaksha/projects/grok/heracles/paper/litcheck/items/r3-phase-lemma/CHECK.md

recommended_citations.why: App. A.3.2 Eq. 15 defines the worst-case amplitude-weighted coverage min_s sum beta_k(1-cos(omega_k s)) as a heuristic loss proxy. It is concurrent and is the closest statement of the RHS of lem:phase.

Thm 4.7 uses the idealized logit h(k)=sum cos(2 pi f_l(k-i-j)/n), whose separation h(i+j)-h(k) is the equal-amplitude coverage sum (1-cos). It supports the sentence that the lemma's RHS is the familiar separation for aligned logits. Title and authors confirmed from the arXiv HTML; replaces the wrong entry in refs.bib.

Sec 3.2 Lemma 5 gives the class-weighted margin. The Sec 4 uniform weighting yields sum u^v^w^. The phase condition theta_u+theta_v=theta_w is in Theorem 7 (Sec 4). Sharpen the citation to 'Theorem 7, Section 4'.
